claim: The GitHub repository page contains publicly accessible project and AI-engineering information.
evidence_text:
This repo has all the resources you need to become an amazing AI engineer!
Join our [free Vibe Coding Bootcamp](https://learn.dataexpert.io/program/vibe-coding-bootcamp-with-adal-799) on Feb 21st and 22nd. We will help you build a SaaS in 48 hours with AI!
If you are new to AI engineering, start by learning the fundamentals of machine learning and then dive into large language models and prompt engineering.
For more applied learning:
- Check out the [projects](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/projects.md) section for hands-on examples!
- Check out the [interviews](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/interviews.md) section for advice on how to pass AI engineering interviews!
- Check out the [books](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/books.md) section for a list of high quality AI engineering books
- Check out the [communities](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/communities.md) section for a list of high quality AI engineering communities to join
- Check out the [newsletters](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/newsletters.md) section to learn via email
Great [list of over 25 books](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/books.md)
Top 3 must read books are:
- [AI Engineering by Chip Huyen](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/ai-engineering/9781098166298/)
- [Designing Machine Learning Systems](https://www.amazon.com/Designing-Machine-Learning-Systems-Production-Ready/dp/1098107969)
- [Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch) by Sebastian Raschka](https://www.manning.com/books/build-a-large-language-model-from-scratch)
Great [list of communities to join](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/communities.md):

Great [list of newsletters](/DataExpert-io/ai-engineer-handbook/blob/main/newsletters.md)
Top must follow newsletters for AI engineering:
- [DeepLearning.AI Short Courses](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/) — Free short courses on LLMs, RAG, agents, and more
- [fast.ai Practical Deep Learning](https://course.fast.ai/) — Free, top-down practical approach to deep learning
- [Stanford CS229: Machine Learning](https://cs229.stanford.edu/) — Andrew Ng's foundational ML course
- [Stanford CS224N: NLP with Deep Learning](https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs224n/) — Chris Manning's NLP course
- [Stanford CS25: Transformers United](https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs25/) — Seminar on transformers
- [Andrej Karpathy's Neural Networks: Zero to Hero](https://karpathy.ai/zero-to-hero.html) — Free YouTube series building neural nets from scratch
- [Full Stack Deep Learning](https://fullstackdeeplearning.com/) — Production ML best practices
- [Hugging Face NLP Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/nlp-course/) — Free comprehensive NLP/transformers course
- [MLOps Zoomcamp by DataTalksClub](https://github.com/DataTalksClub/mlops-zoomcamp) — Free MLOps course
- [Made With ML](https://madewithml.com/) — ML + MLOps course focused on production
- [LLM University by Cohere](https://cohere.com/llmu) — Free LLM fundamentals course
- [Maxime Labonne's LLM Course](https://github.com/mlabonne/llm-course) — Comprehensive LLM roadmap on GitHub
- [Prompt Engineering for Developers by DeepLearning.AI](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/chatgpt-prompt-engineering-for-developers/)
